decisions.decision: The Commission agreed to present the Upland/Eastern and White/Maple Parkway sewer extension to residents as one total project covering both areas (discussed, no vote recorded).
decisions.quote: the commission discussed and agreed to present it as a total project for both areas.

decisions.decision: The solar panel proposal (Green Community request) was put off until the next run, because there was not enough time to pull a proposal together.
decisions.quote: barb informed dave passios that the commission would need to put it off until the next run.

decisions.decision: Barb will contact Graves to tell them the revised 711 Mass Ave plans are coming for peer review.
decisions.quote: barb will contact graves to let them know the plans are coming.

budget_items.topic: Upland/Eastern and White/Maple Parkway sewer extension betterments
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Wright Pierce's preliminary estimates: a gravity sewer would be a betterment of $57K and a low-pressure system $40K, both paid over 20 years; private grinder pump costs fall on residents.
budget_items.quote: the gravity sewer would be a $57k betterment and the low-pressure system would be a $40k betterment- both paid out over 20 years.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Kevin Olson estimated the average septic system costs about $30K, a comparison point for residents facing the sewer extension.
budget_items.quote: kevin estimated the average septic system costs about $30k

budget_items.what_was_recorded: John estimated an internal E-1 pump where there is ledge at $7K plus $500 for the electrical hookup.
budget_items.quote: where there is ledge, the internal pump is the better option and costs $7k plus $500 for the electrical hookup.

budget_items.topic: Gravity versus low-pressure system upfront cost
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Dave said a gravity system would cost a few thousand dollars more upfront than the low-pressure option but could be paid over 20 years as a betterment; no figure was printed.
budget_items.quote: dave stated for few thousand more, they can go with a gravity system and pay over 20 years as a betterment.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Matt reported a recent bid on a grinder pump project with installation at $13K.
budget_items.quote: matt replied that they just bid on a project with cost of $13k for a grinder pump, with installation.

budget_items.topic: CIPP lining cost per linear foot
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Matt gave cured-in-place pipe (CIPP) lining cost estimates for the clay pipes, ranging from $40-70 per linear foot to possibly $100 per linear foot.
budget_items.quote: brett asked kevin if he had cost estimates for cipp and matt replied $40-70/ l.ft. to possibly $100/l.ft.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Dave reported the Commission previously gave $100K to Sewer Maintenance program projects with Rob Oliva.
budget_items.quote: dave said they worked with rob on the sewer maintenance program and gave $100k to those projects.

budget_items.topic: ARPA funding for pump stations and capital work
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Kevin reported a discussion with Rob Oliva about using ARPA funding, suggesting pump stations; no dollar figure was printed.
budget_items.quote: kevin reported that he had a conversation with rob oliva concerning the use of arpa funding.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Dave noted that money should be coming from Build Back America funding; no figure was printed.
budget_items.quote: dave noted that there should be money coming from build back america funding.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Meadowwoods and others paid past-due bills, betterments and tax-lien amounts; no dollar figure was printed for these payments.
budget_items.quote: meadowwoods made a payment on past due bills and betterments, along with others who paid amounts on tax liens.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Barb reported that $225K will go to Retained Earnings when the betterments are applied.
budget_items.quote: there will be $225k going to retained earnings when the betterments are applied.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Barb updated the website with a new rate increase, to be approved with the FY23 budget at Town Meeting; no figure was printed.
budget_items.quote: new rate increase (to be approved with the fy23 budget at town meeting)
